skill.name: weibo-competitor-research
skill.description: Research Weibo competitors through SocialDataX keyword searches, traceable content samples, and evidence-based comparisons.
skill.summary: Compare Weibo content angles using read-only searches and traceable post evidence.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: Thirty matches are false positives involving Markdown, provider links, credential names, and readable Chinese text. One finding confirms automatic execution of an unpinned npm package, creating dependency compromise risk with access to the API key. No evidence found of prompt injection, credential theft, or unauthorized account changes in the supplied files; dependency implementation was not provided.

remediation.issue: The quick-start command automatically downloads and executes socialdatax-skills@latest in an environment containing the API key.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed package version, verify package provenance, and obtain approval before first execution. Restrict the process environment to required credentials.

content.user_title: Research Weibo Competitors With Traceable Evidence
content.value_statement: Weibo competitor research needs relevant samples and verifiable evidence. This skill guides SocialDataX searches and separates observed posts from content strategy judgments.
actual_capabilities: Guide keyword-based Weibo searches through the SocialDataX CLI or the corresponding weibo_search_posts MCP tool.
Control sample size using page counts, item limits, and returned pagination tokens.
Organize content samples with post identifiers, links, authors, engagement metrics, and publication times when available.
Separate visible post evidence from interpretations and proposed follow-up questions.
Continue partial searches using returned tokens while preserving cumulative page and item limits.
limitations: Requires a SocialDataX API key, network access, and available provider credits.
The direct CLI requires Node.js and npm; its documented command executes an unpinned external package.
Search results are samples, not guaranteed complete coverage; the search command does not support --all.
Read-only scope excludes login, posting, likes, comments, and account changes; dependency implementation is not included.

use_cases.title: Compare Brand Content Angles
use_cases.description: Gather relevant competitor posts and compare visible messaging using traceable samples.

use_cases.title: Plan a Content Review
use_cases.description: Collect a bounded set of topic results and distinguish recurring observations from hypotheses.

use_cases.title: Explore a Creator Niche
use_cases.description: Search a topic, inspect relevant authors, and identify questions for deeper content research.

prompt_templates.title: Find Initial Samples
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Weibo for [topic] using one page. Show relevant samples with available authors, links, and post identifiers.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Two Brands
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare Weibo content for [brand A] and [brand B]. Limit each search to [N] items and separate evidence from interpretation.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Evidence Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Research [topic] across [N] pages. Group observed content angles and retain available post links, engagement metrics, and publication times.

prompt_templates.title: Resume an Incomplete Search
prompt_templates.prompt: Continue the partial search for [keyword] using the returned token. Preserve collected evidence and subtract completed pages and items from original limits.

output_examples.input: Show an illustrative comparison format for two competitor samples.
output: Illustrative only; no live search was performed.
Sample A: product demonstration. Sample B: customer story.
Evidence: attach each retrieved post link, author, publication time, and available metrics.
Interpretation: these samples suggest different content angles, not overall account strategies.

output_examples.input: Show an illustrative status report after an interrupted search.
output: Illustrative only; no live search was performed.
Status: incomplete. Retain collected posts and the returned error.
Recovery: resume with the returned continuation token and remaining limits.
Boundary: an empty page does not establish complete search coverage.

best_practices: Start with one page, define a result limit, and expand only when the initial samples support further research.
Preserve available post links, identifiers, and timestamps; label interpretations separately from observed evidence.
Review and pin the CLI dependency before execution, and keep API keys out of prompts and reports.
anti_patterns: Treating sampled search results as complete market coverage or proof of competitor intent.
Restarting partial searches from the first page or ignoring original collection limits.
Requesting account actions or browser credential access outside the documented read-only scope.

faq.question: What inputs does this skill support?
faq.answer: Provide a keyword or topic direction. Add brand names or audience context to narrow the search.

faq.question: What setup is required?
faq.answer: Configure SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY and provider credits. The direct CLI also requires Node.js, npm, and network access.

faq.question: Does this skill change my Weibo account?
faq.answer: The documented workflow is read-only and excludes login, posts, likes, comments, and account changes.

faq.question: Can it retrieve every matching post?
faq.answer: No. Search has no stable complete-result boundary and does not support --all. Use explicit page or item limits.

faq.question: What happens when credits run out?
faq.answer: Stop repeated retries and use the provider billing page. After funding, resume partial searches with the returned token and remaining limits.

faq.question: Is the external CLI included in this audit?
faq.answer: No. The supplied files document its invocation, not its implementation. Review and pin the package before running it with credentials.
